story.title: My diary!
paragraphs_en: My name is Aisha and I am 10 years old. This book is about my daily diary. Read the next pages if you want to. --------------------------------------------------------------- /17 I live in a small neighborhood in Noida and all the people who live there ( even the kids ) have a group. There are about 120 children in our neighborhood and we have been divided into groups by the people who own our houses. Today my friend Gauri just told us that she is moving to Mumbai, oh no! When I tell this to Muma, she is quite not- surprised. " Oh, Anushka (Gauri's muma) told me yesterday when you Gauri, Meena, and Kimara (my friends)were playing at the park, me, Anushka, Pinky, and Amalika ( my friends's moms) were having a group FaceTime call and Anushka told us this news.

" said muma. I still can't believe that Gauri is leaving. I said to muma " muma we have to make Gauri and Anushka aunty the best Farewell party". Muma says " of course we will Aisha. We will start planning tomorrow, ok".For dinner today we had some delicious pasta and I cried " muma we have to put this on the menu for the farewell." Papa said " Arre, who's farewell? Oh, is this Rahul Gupta's farewell you talking about ( Rahul Gupta is Gauri's Dad. Papa likes to call him by his full name, not only Rahul.)" papa how do you know? And Pankaj Bhaya (my older annoying elder brother) do you also know?" I ask. " Of course I know. Kirti ( Gauri's closest cousin) told me." Big Bhaya's seem to know everything. Anyways good night. I will write tomorrow.

/19 Today is a school day and cybersecurity day and tomorrow is Saturday. And today at school some Didi's from class 12th came and told us about cybersecurity. " today you youngsters will be making your own chart on cybersecurity." one Didi said. We are not youngsters! We are 5th graders. Most of us are 10 years old! After making the chart the Didi's left and we voted which looked best and has the most information. I came first and Sameena Dingra ( one girl in my class ) came last because she drew the most and wrote the least. And plus she's the least to succeed: voted by the class president Raj Sharma. He is a fat and rich boy who keeps giving his friends money thinking that they are his friends but they are not his friends. They just pretend to be his friends so they get money.

Ma'am said that since Raj Sharma has so many friends he shall be class president. Ma'am should have made me class president because I'm so kind and I would never put poor Sameena in such a difficult spot. Second thing about Raj: he doesn't have respect. Suppose he has this maid and her name is Tweety. When he calls her he is like " Oh, Tweety come here ". He calls her by her name! She is 26 years old and he is 11 years old. And he is really good at drawing since he started doing art classes since he was 5 years old. Of course, since he is so rich he can throw around money everywhere. Last year, he joined this school, and our class and I heard rumors that he got kicked out of his first school and his parents did not mind and just put him in this school. If I were in his place I would have been scolded like how.

/17 Sorry, I wrote after a long time. We had a really hard math quiz to do and loads of homework. I really wish homework was not invented. It is so boring and if we didn't have it then we would catch up with our friends, watch tons of t.v and play video games. Anyway, today we have to plan tons of the farewell and I am so not going to help muma, Pinky aunty, and Amalika auntie. I, Meena, and Kimara are going to play loads of video games while those Ladies are going to chat all day long, order some stuff and call people for delivery. After half an hour I, Meena and Kimara are really hungry. So our mum's make us some yummy Nutella and peanut butter sandwich and tell us about the farewell. " We will be hosting it at Meena's house because it is really big, and girls this is a surprise farewell so please don't tell Gauri, Rahul uncle or Anushka aunty. Understood " says muma. " yes Auntie " says Kimara on my and Meena's behalf.

/17 Today is the food truck party! A food truck party happens in neighborhoods in Sector 2 ( the sector where I live ) monthly. It happens on every 19th of a month. On the day of the food truck party there is a theme of food to eat. Suppose last month on 19th June the theme was Italian and it happens in the night so the rest of the meals will not be Italian at all. If you don't follow this rule then you will not get to the Italian party. And food trucks all over the sector will serve Italian. Last month, Pankaj Bhaya didn't go because he ate pasta for lunch. Everyone gets a message of the theme the night before the party. In every neighborhood, there are at least 30 food trucks. Sometimes you can put up your own food truck, like last month me Gauri, Kimara, and Meena put a lemonade truck in Kimara's car and made our own lemonade. We made Rs 1500 last year because it was really hot and people needed a refreshment and we gave them a chilled lemonade for Rs 10.

The theme of this year is Mexican I think, and mummy told me that there is going to be a chocolate and vegan taco truck. Yum! " My muma told me that there is going to be a fruit custard stand too, Aisha! I can't believe this is my last food truck party," says Gauri sadly. " Didn't your muma say you are going to leave on 19th August?" Kimara says. " oh, no she will leave on the day of a food truck party! " said Meena. Gauri said " I don't think so. Pops ( what Gauri calls her father ) told me that we will leave at 12 'o'clock in the night and the party stops at 10 only." oh yay, you not going to miss it " I say. Then suddenly a singer jumps on to the stage of the food truck party and says " we want to thank you for coming to this food truck party. We want to celebrate the leaving of a member of this special group who is standing right next to the stage. Say your farewells to miss Gauri Gupta, Mr Rahul Gupta and Mrs Anushka Gupta." I hear lots of clapping so I start clapping too. Then my parents and I go into Meena's humangas mansion.

I asked my mum why is the farewell so early and she said that because Gauri will leave at 12:00 today. What a coincidence !! Instead of the party happening outside like usual it happened in Meena's house. After tons of partying, we finally had to say goodbye to Gauri. We were really sad because when I had just moved to sector 2 Noida from Gurgaon DLF, I was sitting alone in the park and she comforted me and became my first friend in Noida. I was feeling really sad when she left but I knew I would visit her in Mumbai and I could easily text with her on the computer.

/17 Today I woke up at 5:00 so I can text Gauri if she is awake. I start texting her and she texts back. After 1 hour of texting, she goes to sleep and I get ready for school. Suddenly, I see raindrops pouring. Half an hour later, muma gets an email from the school saying that the school is closed due to heavy rain. Yay, no school. But muma even gets an email saying that Pankaj Bhaya will go to school because he is in 9th grade. No Bhaya also! And mummy, papa have to go work. But no school for me! My parents drop me off at Kimara's and Meena comes over too because even both her parents go to work. My parents dropped me off at Kimara's house because it is huge and her mum is a stay at home and she has many maids to take care of her. We play and eat lunch with her, then my and Meena's mum come to pick us up and we really had a fun time!

/17 Today Meena has some news to tell us. I'll give you the hint she gave me and Kimara. Meena's hint: I am an only child. Could you figure out something? Well, Kimara did. " oh, you are getting a puppy?" she says. Meena tells her " Yes! We are definitely getting a puppy"." Guys, we will talk about this later. There is a movie releasing today its name is Descendants 2". I say. " Have we even watched Descendants 1, and you are saying we can watch part 2," Kimara says. Meena replies " yeah, we don't even know what is Descendants is,". " Don't worry. My father got premiere tickets from his office to go to the Descendants 1 movie." I said. " do our parents know about this?" Kimara worried. " yes of course they know. Aisha told her father to tell our parents." Meena said. And it was set. We put on our best clothes and went to the movie theater with our fathers.
So, after the movie, we were really happy and Kimara and Meena's parents gave the money to my Papa. That is the end of my diary. BYE!!

items.text_en: My name is Aisha and I am 10 years old.
This book is about my daily diary.
Read the next pages if you want to.
--------------------------------------------------------------- /17 I live in a small neighborhood in Noida and all the people who live there ( even the kids ) have a group.
There are about 120 children in our neighborhood and we have been divided into groups by the people who own our houses.
Today my friend Gauri just told us that she is moving to Mumbai, oh no!
When I tell this to Muma, she is quite not- surprised.

" Oh, Anushka (Gauri's muma) told me yesterday when you Gauri, Meena, and Kimara (my friends)were playing at the park, me, Anushka, Pinky, and Amalika ( my friends's moms) were having a group FaceTime call and Anushka told us this news.
" said muma.
I still can't believe that Gauri is leaving.
I said to muma " muma we have to make Gauri and Anushka aunty the best Farewell party".
Muma says " of course we will Aisha.
We will start planning tomorrow, ok".For dinner today we had some delicious pasta and I cried " muma we have to put this on the menu for the farewell." Papa said " Arre, who's farewell?
Oh, is this Rahul Gupta's farewell you talking about ( Rahul Gupta is Gauri's Dad.
Papa likes to call him by his full name, not only Rahul.)" papa how do you know?
And Pankaj Bhaya (my older annoying elder brother) do you also know?" I ask.
" Of course I know.
Kirti ( Gauri's closest cousin) told me." Big Bhaya's seem to know everything.
Anyways good night.
I will write tomorrow.
/19 Today is a school day and cybersecurity day and tomorrow is Saturday.
And today at school some Didi's from class 12th came and told us about cybersecurity.
" today you youngsters will be making your own chart on cybersecurity." one Didi said.
We are not youngsters!
We are 5th graders.
Most of us are 10 years old!
After making the chart the Didi's left and we voted which looked best and has the most information.
I came first and Sameena Dingra ( one girl in my class ) came last because she drew the most and wrote the least.
And plus she's the least to succeed: voted by the class president Raj Sharma.
He is a fat and rich boy who keeps giving his friends money thinking that they are his friends but they are not his friends.
They just pretend to be his friends so they get money.
Ma'am said that since Raj Sharma has so many friends he shall be class president.
Ma'am should have made me class president because I'm so kind and I would never put poor Sameena in such a difficult spot.
Second thing about Raj: he doesn't have respect.
Suppose he has this maid and her name is Tweety.
When he calls her he is like " Oh, Tweety come here ".
He calls her by her name!
She is 26 years old and he is 11 years old.
And he is really good at drawing since he started doing art classes since he was 5 years old.
Of course, since he is so rich he can throw around money everywhere.
Last year, he joined this school, and our class and I heard rumors that he got kicked out of his first school and his parents did not mind and just put him in this school.
If I were in his place I would have been scolded like how.
/17 Sorry, I wrote after a long time.
We had a really hard math quiz to do and loads of homework.
I really wish homework was not invented.
It is so boring and if we didn't have it then we would catch up with our friends, watch tons of t.v and play video games.
Anyway, today we have to plan tons of the farewell and I am so not going to help muma, Pinky aunty, and Amalika auntie.
I, Meena, and Kimara are going to play loads of video games while those Ladies are going to chat all day long, order some stuff and call people for delivery.
After half an hour I, Meena and Kimara are really hungry.
So our mum's make us some yummy Nutella and peanut butter sandwich and tell us about the farewell.
" We will be hosting it at Meena's house because it is really big, and girls this is a surprise farewell so please don't tell Gauri, Rahul uncle or Anushka aunty.
Understood " says muma.
" yes Auntie " says Kimara on my and Meena's behalf.
/17 Today is the food truck party!
A food truck party happens in neighborhoods in Sector 2 ( the sector where I live ) monthly.
It happens on every 19th of a month.
On the day of the food truck party there is a theme of food to eat.
Suppose last month on 19th June the theme was Italian and it happens in the night so the rest of the meals will not be Italian at all.
If you don't follow this rule then you will not get to the Italian party.
And food trucks all over the sector will serve Italian.
Last month, Pankaj Bhaya didn't go because he ate pasta for lunch.
Everyone gets a message of the theme the night before the party.
In every neighborhood, there are at least 30 food trucks.
Sometimes you can put up your own food truck, like last month me Gauri, Kimara, and Meena put a lemonade truck in Kimara's car and made our own lemonade.
We made Rs 1500 last year because it was really hot and people needed a refreshment and we gave them a chilled lemonade for Rs 10.
The theme of this year is Mexican I think, and mummy told me that there is going to be a chocolate and vegan taco truck.
Yum! " My muma told me that there is going to be a fruit custard stand too, Aisha!
I can't believe this is my last food truck party," says Gauri sadly.
" Didn't your muma say you are going to leave on 19th August?" Kimara says.
" oh, no she will leave on the day of a food truck party!
" said Meena.
Gauri said " I don't think so.
Pops ( what Gauri calls her father ) told me that we will leave at 12 'o'clock in the night and the party stops at 10 only." oh yay, you not going to miss it " I say.
Then suddenly a singer jumps on to the stage of the food truck party and says " we want to thank you for coming to this food truck party.
We want to celebrate the leaving of a member of this special group who is standing right next to the stage.
Say your farewells to miss Gauri Gupta, Mr Rahul Gupta and Mrs Anushka Gupta." I hear lots of clapping so I start clapping too.
Then my parents and I go into Meena's humangas mansion.
I asked my mum why is the farewell so early and she said that because Gauri will leave at 12:00 today.
What a coincidence !!
Instead of the party happening outside like usual it happened in Meena's house.
After tons of partying, we finally had to say goodbye to Gauri.
We were really sad because when I had just moved to sector 2 Noida from Gurgaon DLF, I was sitting alone in the park and she comforted me and became my first friend in Noida.
I was feeling really sad when she left but I knew I would visit her in Mumbai and I could easily text with her on the computer.
/17 Today I woke up at 5:00 so I can text Gauri if she is awake.
I start texting her and she texts back.
After 1 hour of texting, she goes to sleep and I get ready for school.
Suddenly, I see raindrops pouring.
Half an hour later, muma gets an email from the school saying that the school is closed due to heavy rain.
Yay, no school.
But muma even gets an email saying that Pankaj Bhaya will go to school because he is in 9th grade.
No Bhaya also!
And mummy, papa have to go work.
But no school for me!
My parents drop me off at Kimara's and Meena comes over too because even both her parents go to work.
My parents dropped me off at Kimara's house because it is huge and her mum is a stay at home and she has many maids to take care of her.
We play and eat lunch with her, then my and Meena's mum come to pick us up and we really had a fun time!
/17 Today Meena has some news to tell us.
I'll give you the hint she gave me and Kimara.
Meena's hint: I am an only child.
Could you figure out something?
Well, Kimara did.
" oh, you are getting a puppy?" she says.
Meena tells her " Yes!
We are definitely getting a puppy"." Guys, we will talk about this later.
There is a movie releasing today its name is Descendants 2".
I say. " Have we even watched Descendants 1, and you are saying we can watch part 2," Kimara says.
Meena replies " yeah, we don't even know what is Descendants is,".
" Don't worry.
My father got premiere tickets from his office to go to the Descendants 1 movie." I said.
" do our parents know about this?" Kimara worried.
" yes of course they know.
Aisha told her father to tell our parents." Meena said.
And it was set.
We put on our best clothes and went to the movie theater with our fathers.
So, after the movie, we were really happy and Kimara and Meena's parents gave the money to my Papa.
That is the end of my diary. BYE!!
